For the optunahub library, you can install it via conda-forge using `conda install conda-forge::optunahub`. The GitHub discussions page mentions updates to GitHub actions and various enhancements to the project, but does not provide direct installation instructions beyond these details.
To install Optuna, you can use either pip or Anaconda Cloud. The sources indicate that Optuna is available at the Python Package Index (PyPI) and on Anaconda Cloud.
